entries.text: 我是橘子学院的校长，\n克拉韦尔。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_first_01

entries.text: 我是葡萄学院的校长，\n克拉韦尔。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_first_01b

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学你的精彩表现，\n我已经从席蓝校长那里听说了哦。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_00

entries.text: 他说你在社团活动里拿下了第一名，\n还很积极地参加校外活动。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_01

entries.text: 我身为学院的校长，\n也为你感到很自豪啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_02

entries.text: 你在蓝莓学园的生活\n过得还好吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_03

entries.text: 很开心！
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 你能这么回答我真的很高兴。\n你来这里，真是来得太好了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_04

entries.text: 莫非你有很多烦心事吗？\c\n……如果遇到了什么事，\n随时欢迎你回来。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_04b

entries.text: 我暂时还会在这边\n当一阵子特邀教员。\r\n你有什么事的话，请来告诉我。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp01_05

entries.text: 话说，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学，\n你在学园里有什么烦心事吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_00

entries.text: 比如说……\n被席蓝校长折腾来折腾去，\r\n被交代一些你根本无法完成的难题之类的？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_01

entries.text: 完全没事！
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 他人很好！
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 这样啊……\n那我就放心了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_02

entries.text: 我和席蓝校长\n以前就读同一所学校。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_03

entries.text: 我从那个时候开始\n就被他折腾来折腾去的。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_04

entries.text: 在我以校长的身份\n去学院赴任的时候也是……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_05

entries.text: “小韦你啊，缺的就是威严。\n 要不你把纪念球挂在腰上试试！？”[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_06

entries.text: 他对我说了这样的话……\n言听计从的我也有问题就是了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_07

entries.text: 如果你遇上了什么事，\n就请随时和我联络吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp02_08

entries.text: 由于[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学\n你在蓝莓学园这边留学……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_00

entries.text: 我也因此\n会常来这边了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_01

entries.text: 来学院以外的学校看看，\n会有非常多的收获。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_02

entries.text: 我打算把这里的优点导入学院，\n请让我听听你的意见。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学，\n你最喜欢蓝莓学园的哪一点？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_04

entries.text: 校风
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 地点
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 设备
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 校长
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_select_04

entries.text:
嗯嗯……\c
这里盛行宝可梦对战，
又重视学生的自主性……\c
就是这些部分让[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学你
喜欢上了学园，对吧？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05

entries.text:
嗯嗯……\c
浮在海上的学园
确实叫人赞叹不已。\c
但是要学院也走这一步的话，
就得把校舍整个搬走……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05b

entries.text:
嗯嗯……\c
生态巨蛋的确很适合
用来观察宝可梦的生态。\c
当然，我认为帕底亚的大自然
并没有输给它……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05c

entries.text:
啊！校长我好受打击！\c
虽然席蓝校长的确
是个很优秀的人……\c
但如果他来当学院的校长，
我就只能打包走人了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_05d

entries.text: ……谢谢你。\n我会当做参考的。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_sp03_06

entries.text: 像这样和你聊着聊着，\n我就想起了你第一次去学院，\r\n我把[VAR 0x0101(0002)]交给你的那天。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_00

entries.text: 我相信你在那之后\n应该找到了许许多多的宝物……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_01

entries.text: 你愿意拿出其中一个宝物……\n来和我交换宝可梦，让我也见识一下吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_02

entries.text: 谢谢你。\n我会给你布土拨。\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学，你呢？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_03

entries.text:
谢谢你把如同宝物般的
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]交换给我。\c
我会负起责任来
好好照顾它的。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_01_04

entries.text: 你确定要用[VAR 0x0101(0001)]和\n我的布土拨交换吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_02_03

entries.text:
哎呀！你的同行宝可梦
只有１只啊。\c
请你先带着２只以上的宝可梦，
再来和我交换吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_03_00

entries.text: 请好好考虑。\n等你决定好了再来吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_03_01

entries.text: 你愿意和我交换宝可梦，\n让我见识一下你找到的宝物吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_trade_04_00

entries.text: 哎呀？[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学，\n你是来邀请我对战的吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_talkto_00

entries.text: 如果你有什么想商量的事，\n请随时来和我说。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_cancel_00

entries.text: 那我就不以校长的身份，\n而是以训练家的身份和你对战吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 看来你找到了\n很多的宝物啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: ……哎呀！\n校长我差点忘了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 我的朋友有礼物想送给你，\n我还替他保管着呢。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 这可是非常新潮的头饰。\n我自己也很想要哦。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从克拉韦尔校长\n获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]聂凯头盔[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_reward_00

entries.text: 真是一场精彩的对战。\n让我们赞美彼此的奋战吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 你记得要让[VAR 0x0101(0002)]\n好好地休息啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
真是一场无论哪方获胜
都不奇怪的白热化对战。\c
战败之后该怎么做才是最重要的。
我相信你应该明白这一点。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
新叶喵、呆火鳄、润水鸭，
这３只算是比较好照料的宝可梦。\c
因此我们学院才会将它们
指定为交给新生的宝可梦。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
我们没有为寻宝设定
具体的截止时间。\c
还请[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你继续享受
只属于自己的大冒险。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
你要找席蓝校长的话，
我刚刚在入口看到了他。\c
他到底有没有好好
做文书工作啊……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_02

entries.text: 你交换给我的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n非常粘人。\r\n不肯从我的身边离开啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我交换给你的布土拨
最近还好吗？\c
其实它是我去拜访你家之后的
回程路上捉到的哦。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_head_randomtalk_04
